# GT News - Large Language Model Context File
# This file provides context for AI search engines and LLMs about GT News content

## About GT News
GT News (जीटी न्यूज च्यानल) is a Nepali news website providing trusted, accurate, and timely news coverage primarily focused on Nepal. We cover local news, politics, events, and regional developments in Parsa district and beyond.

## Content Focus
- Local Nepal news and events
- Political developments
- Community stories
- Regional news coverage
- Breaking news updates

## Content Language
Primary language: Nepali (नेपाली)
Secondary language: English (limited)

## Content Structure
- Homepage: Latest news, trending articles, featured stories
- Categories: Organized by topic (politics, local news, etc.)
- Articles: In-depth news coverage with images and metadata
- Search: Full-text search functionality

## Key Topics
- Nepal politics and government
- Local Parsa district news
- Regional development
- Community events
- Breaking news

## Content Quality Guidelines
- Factual, verified information
- Neutral, balanced reporting
- Source attribution where applicable
- Regular updates with breaking news
- Press Council Nepal registered (304268/079/080)
